# Comym

> Portfolio of Gabriel Comym, a product design leader working across AI, data, expert workflows, and complex technical products.

## Profile

- Name: Gabriel Comym
- Role: Product Design Leader
- Expertise: product design, design direction, AI and machine-learning workflows, data products, technical and enterprise UX, systems thinking, product strategy, and creative technology.
- About: https://comym.co/about/
- Contact: mailto:gabrielcomym@gmail.com
- Insights: https://gabrielcomym.medium.com/

## Selected work

- [Kedro](https://comym.co/case-studies/kedro/): Product design and design direction for a mature open-source and enterprise data-science product experience, including Kedro-Viz.
- [Rivendell](https://comym.co/case-studies/rivendell/): A prescriptive-analytics planning concept for a mineral-export port operation, designed as a human-in-the-loop decision-support experience.
- [WovenLight](https://comym.co/case-studies/wovenlight/): AI-assisted workflows for high-stakes investment analysis and private-equity value creation.
- [PerformanceAI](https://comym.co/case-studies/performanceai/): A 0-to-1 product vision for machine-learning model monitoring, alerts, comparison, and corrective action.
